description: Check the registration status of up to 50 domains at a point in time. available means the domain can be registered; registered means it is already registered; expiring means it is in an expiry-related lifecycle and is not directly registrable; reserved means it is reserved by the registry; unknown means no check produced a reliable conclusion. Availability is never assumed from a failed check.

domains.description: Comma-separated fully qualified domain names, maximum 50.

name: bulk_available

price.description: Registration price including currency, when available.

error.description: Error message when success is false.

title: Batch Domain Availability Check
